sections.title: Logging
sections.description: What ChiSurf reported while it ran: messages, warnings and errors.
The log, newest last. Rows the filter does not match are dimmed, or hidden with Hide.

context_menu.label: Copy message
context_menu.description: Copy the message text of this row to the clipboard.

context_menu.label: Copy row
context_menu.description: Copy this log row to the clipboard.

context_menu.label: Copy all visible
context_menu.description: Copy all visible log lines to the clipboard.

columns.label: Origin
columns.description: The part of ChiSurf that wrote it.

sections.label: Filter
sections.description: Show the messages that contain this text; the others are dimmed (or hidden with Hide).

sections.label: Level
sections.description: The least serious messages shown: DEBUG shows everything, ERROR only errors.

sections.label: Hide
sections.description: Hide the messages the filter does not match instead of dimming them.

buttons.label: Copy
buttons.description: Copy all visible log messages to the clipboard.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Forget the messages shown so far.

sections.title: RPC Monitor
sections.description: Every call the ChiSurf server answered: what was asked, how long it took, whether it worked.

buttons.label: Copy
buttons.description: Copy all visible calls to the clipboard.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Forget the calls shown so far.

sections.label: Pause
sections.description: Stop recording calls while on; the table keeps what it has.

context_menu.label: Copy call
context_menu.description: Copy this server call to the clipboard.

context_menu.label: Copy parameters
context_menu.description: Copy the parameters of this call to the clipboard.

context_menu.label: Copy all visible
context_menu.description: Copy all visible server calls to the clipboard.

columns.label: Status
columns.description: OK, or the error code it answered with.

sections.label: Filter
sections.description: Show the calls whose method, status or parameters contain this text.

sections.title: History
sections.description: The changes to the science you can go back to: a click on a step goes to it (as Undo and Redo do).

sections.label: Filter
sections.description: Show the steps whose action or summary contain this text.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Forget the steps; what is open now stays as it is.

sections.description: The steps, oldest first; ▶ marks where you are. Click a step to go back (or forward) to it.
The selected step, as it is recorded.
